I_ACCESS.description: Users report difficulty logging in, creating an account, or using the service in some locations.

I_BILLING.description: Users object to subscription requirements and limits on song selection and playback features.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs, limited catalog content, and search problems.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report trouble saving music, maintaining downloads, and listening offline.

I_OTHER.description: Users express general dissatisfaction or disappointment without specifying a particular product problem.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report songs failing to play or stopping, along with connection and update-related playback problems.

I_SUPPORT.description: Users report difficulty reaching support, unhelpful responses, and limits on assistance.

I_USABILITY.description: Users report frustrating controls and navigation, frequent ads, and unwanted audio behavior.
